name: Misty Shore
summary: Along Lordamere Lake's eastern bank, Misty Shore lies between Dandred's Fold and Dalaran. Fog softens the view across the water, where the Dawning Isles and Fenris Keep rise in the distance.

sections.title: A Fog-Shrouded Waterline
sections.body: Misty Shore follows Lordamere Lake's eastern bank between Dandred's Fold and Dalaran. Damp air drifts off the water, often hiding snapping turtles along the shore. Zealous fanatics sometimes wander down from nearby strongholds.

sections.title: Watching the Lake
sections.body: Across Lordamere Lake, the Dawning Isles and Fenris Keep rise through the fog. Dalaran lies nearby, with Scarlet-controlled pockets close at hand. Travelers keep a low profile along the bank to avoid unwanted attention.

faq.q: Where is the Misty Shore located?
faq.answer: Misty Shore follows the eastern shore of Lordamere Lake in the Alterac Mountains, between Dandred's Fold and Dalaran's perimeter.

faq.q: What can be seen across the water from here?
faq.answer: From the shore you can make out the Dawning Isles and Fenris Keep across Lordamere Lake, half hidden in fog.

faq.q: What threats are typically found along the shore?
faq.answer: Snapping turtles inhabit the shoreline. Travelers may also encounter Scarlet Crusade zealots or scouts from nearby farmsteads and ruins.

angles.text: Snapping turtles along Lordamere Lake provide meat for cooks traveling through Alterac.
The misty bank offers a sheltered approach between Forsaken-held lands near Tarren Mill and the northern lakeshore, away from open patrols.
